Run GSEA (fgsea) on DE results

Source: R/analysis_enrich.R
run_gsea.Rd

Run GSEA (fgsea) on DE results

Usage

run_gsea(
  res,
  gene_sets,
  rank_by = "stat",
  min_size = 15,
  max_size = 500,
  eps = 0
)

Arguments

res

DE results data.frame

gene_sets

named list of gene sets (from get_gene_sets())

rank_by

ranking metric passed to rank_genes()

min_size, max_size

gene-set size filters

eps

fgsea boundary for p-value estimation (0 = most accurate)

Value

a tidy data.frame sorted by padj with columns: pathway, pval, padj, NES, ES, size, leadingEdge (list-column) and leading_edge (string)
